tagline.zh: 获取目标的时间取决于目标的距离与大小:目标越小、越远,命中越慢、错误越多。触控目标要大、间距要足、离注意力区要近。
tagline.en: Time to acquire a target is a function of its distance and size: smaller and farther targets take longer and fail more. Make touch targets big, well spaced, and close to the focus area.

origin.zh: 1954 年心理学家 Paul Fitts 研究人类运动系统时提出:移动到目标的时间随距离增加、与目标大小成反比;快速动作配小目标会因速度-精度权衡而放大错误率(Jon Yablonski,Laws of UX)。该定律直接催生了「移动端交互按钮要大」的惯例(调研 07§22)。
origin.en: In 1954 psychologist Paul Fitts showed that time to move to a target grows with distance and shrinks with target size; fast movements to small targets raise error rates via the speed-accuracy trade-off (Jon Yablonski, Laws of UX). The law directly spawned the convention of large interactive buttons on mobile (research 07 §22).

effect.zh: 目标按钮边长。默认 48px 取 M3 的触控目标规格(target 48dp,M3 Switch 规格,调研 04§2.1);lawsofux 指导:触控目标要足够大、相互间留足间距。调到 16px 体验小目标的手感对比。
effect.en: Edge length of the target button. Default 48px comes from M3's touch target spec (target 48dp, M3 Switch specs, research 04 §2.1); Laws of UX guidance: targets should be large and well spaced. Drag to 16px to feel small targets.

effect.zh: 起点按钮与目标按钮之间的水平间隙(以边距近似 Fitts 的运动幅度)。Fitts 1954:距离越远,移动时间越长;lawsofux 指导:任务注意区与相关按钮的距离尽量短。
effect.en: Horizontal gap between the start button and the target (edge distance approximating Fitts' movement amplitude). Fitts 1954: longer distances take longer; Laws of UX guidance: keep the distance between the task focus area and the related button short.

note.zh: 心理学定律本身无浏览器支持问题;演示用 Pointer 事件计时,全现代浏览器可用。
note.en: As a psychological law there is no browser support question; the demo times clicks with Pointer events, available in all modern browsers.

fallback.zh: 定律不可「降级」,但落地到 UI 有两条工程底线:触控目标的最小可命中尺寸交给 CSS(padding/min-width 保证),误触的后果交给撤销与确认,而不是把按钮做小。
fallback.en: The law cannot 'degrade', but its UI implications have two engineering floors: guarantee minimum hit size via CSS (padding/min-width) and absorb mistaps with undo and confirmation instead of shrinking buttons.

use.zh: 移动端主要操作按钮与底部导航项——用 48px 级目标(04§2.1)
use.en: Primary mobile actions and bottom-nav items — 48px-class targets (research 04 §2.1)

use.zh: 销毁类操作:目标做小 + 远离高频区,是 Fitts 的合法反向运用
use.en: Destructive actions: shrink and move them away from hot zones — a legitimate inverse use of Fitts

use.zh: 工具栏与表单:把主按钮放在注意力停留处附近
use.en: Toolbars and forms: put the primary button near where attention rests

avoid.zh: 密集小图标按钮相互贴身排列——间距不足会放大误触
avoid.en: Dense icon buttons packed together — insufficient spacing amplifies mistaps

avoid.zh: 把关键操作移到屏幕远角以「腾地方」
avoid.en: Relocating key actions to far screen corners to 'make room'

a11y.zh: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8(目标尺寸最低,AA)要求指针目标至少 24×24 CSS px;M3 的 target 48dp 是更宽松的生产参照(调研 04§2.1)。仅靠 hover 呈现的目标对触屏与运动障碍用户不可用;小目标必须配足间距,否则与相邻目标互相抢命中区。
a11y.en: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 (Target Size Minimum, AA) requires pointer targets of at least 24×24 CSS px; M3's target 48dp is a roomier production reference (research 04 §2.1). Hover-only targets are unusable for touch and motor-impaired users; small targets need ample spacing or they compete with neighbors for hits.

goal.zh: 做一个 Fitts 定律对照实验:一个起点按钮与一个可调尺寸/距离的目标按钮,点击起点开始计时、命中目标结束,实时显示耗时、难度指数 ID=log₂(2D/W) 与错误计数,让使用者亲手感受目标大小与距离对获取时间的影响。
goal.en: Build a Fitts's-law experiment: a start button plus a target button whose size and distance are adjustable; clicking start starts a timer, hitting the target stops it — show elapsed time, difficulty index ID=log₂(2D/W) and error count live.

acceptance.zh: 目标边长与水平间隙严格使用参数快照值(size 默认 48px= M3 target 48dp)
acceptance.en: Target size and gap use the exact parameter snapshot values (size default 48px = M3 target 48dp)

acceptance.zh: 计时从点击起点开始、到命中目标结束,误差之外的点击计入 miss
acceptance.en: Timing starts on the start click and stops on the target hit; clicks landing outside count as misses

acceptance.zh: 展示难度指数 ID=log₂(2D/W)(Shannon 形式)并标注公式出处
acceptance.en: Show the difficulty index ID=log₂(2D/W) (Shannon form) with the formula attributed

acceptance.zh: 起点与目标均为可 Tab 聚焦的真实按钮,焦点环不被移除
acceptance.en: Start and target are real, Tab-focusable buttons with focus rings intact

acceptance.zh: 错误计数与最近几次成绩可见,便于对比不同 size/distance 的手感
acceptance.en: Miss count and the last few results stay visible so different size/distance settings can be compared
